question: Which of the following has launched the ‘DBT-Star College Mentorship Programme’ in November 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Science and Technolog**__**y**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) Science & Technology** Dr. Jitendra Singh **launched the **first-ever Mentorship Programme named ‘DBT-Star College Mentorship Programme for**** Young Innovators to mark the 75th Year of India’s Independence.**
 
• It is a pan India Scheme that **envisages Star College in every district of the country supported by the Department of Biotechnology**.
 
• The plan includes **organizing workshops, and meetings per month; handhold at colleges particularly in the rural areas or lesser endowed areas, and conducting outreach activities with government schools.**
 
• The** Star Status Colleges will help in incorporating the vision of DBT towards strengthening UG Science Courses** throughout the country by **mentoring the newer colleges through hand-holding and peer learning and bringing them under the aegis of the Star College Scheme.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• In the launch event on **08 NOV 2021, Delhi Dr. Jitendra Singh informed that a total of 278 undergraduate colleges across the country **are currently being supported under the **DBT Star College Scheme.**
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh__ **is** **also the
 
 
• **​​Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Science and Technology**
 
• **Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Earth Sciences**
 
• **Minister of State in the Prime Minister’s Office**
 
• **Minister of State in the Ministry of Personnel**
 
• **Public Grievances and Pensions**
